# Adam Hickey

> Independent product designer in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Product design for software that got complicated, plus identity and illustration made end to end. Twenty years inside enterprise platforms, design systems, and products that outgrew their original shape. Works with product leaders across the United States, remotely and in person.

Contact: adam@adamhickey.com. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/adamdhickey/

Every page is plain HTML with its content in the markup; nothing is rendered by script. Each page carries a canonical URL, an Open Graph card and a schema.org graph (Person, ProfessionalService, Article, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList), and https://adamhickey.com/sitemap.xml lists all fifteen pages with a last-modified date.

## Engagements

The four things you can hire. Each page states who it is for, how long it takes, how it is priced, what the client's team gives and what they leave with, and answers the questions people ask.

- [Product Clarity](https://adamhickey.com/engagement/product-clarity.html): turn a complicated product into one agreed problem, a sequence of decisions, and a direction the team can judge. Two to four weeks, fixed scope and fixed fee.
- [Design System Foundation](https://adamhickey.com/engagement/design-system-foundation.html): one shared foundation that several teams actually use, with the operating rules that keep it that way. A three-week fixed-fee diagnostic, then a build scoped from it, usually two to three months.
- [Embedded Senior Product Design](https://adamhickey.com/engagement/embedded-senior-product-design.html): a senior owner for an initiative that has none, inside the team rather than beside it. Three to six months, two to four days a week, priced as reserved weekly capacity.
- [Working Product Prototype](https://adamhickey.com/engagement/working-product-prototype.html): from ideas and sketches to a working product real people can use, and an honest build, kill, or park call. Four to six weeks, fixed scope and fixed fee.

## Case studies

- [One real-time view of a 450+ truck fleet](https://adamhickey.com/case-study/dispatch-complexity.html): lead product design for Midwest Couriers, a research-led dispatch cockpit.
- [Making 40+ enterprise apps feel like one product](https://adamhickey.com/case-study/sap-product-maturity.html): lead UX for a global corporation's SAP Fiori suite, under a governed design system and an accessibility standard.
- [Grant tools unified into one trusted platform](https://adamhickey.com/case-study/usda-operational-overhead.html): lead product design for the USDA-backed Nutrition Incentive Hub.
- [A global innovation network on one brand and platform](https://adamhickey.com/case-study/innovators-studio-visual-identity.html): identity and a multi-year internal platform for a worldwide innovation network.
- [13 years as an enterprise design consultant](https://adamhickey.com/case-study/enterprise-consulting.html): the RBA years, 2013 to 2026, for CBRE, Toro, Banner Bank and International Trucks.
- [8 years as a hybrid designer / developer](https://adamhickey.com/case-study/hybrid-designer.html): three Minneapolis studios, 2005 to 2013, the last five years at Pixel Farm.

## Built end to end

Products designed, built and illustrated alone.

- [How I built Door County Found](https://adamhickey.com/case-study/door-county-found.html): a curated travel guide where every place is structured data, built on Astro and edited through a web form.
- [How I built Lucy Learns](https://adamhickey.com/case-study/lucy-learns.html): an offline-first dog-training app, with the AI driven from a terminal.
- [How I built While We're Here](https://adamhickey.com/case-study/while-were-here.html): a 300mm square hardcover of essays produced from HTML and CSS through a paged-media engine.
